title: How Not to Build Microcrypt
summary: A key challenge in quantum cryptography is to build quantum one-wayness and pseudorandomness without the use of (quantum computable) one-way functions. So far, this has turned out to be a difficult task, with only a few proposed candidates that are not directly built from one-way functions. Even within these few proposed candidates, we have lacked the techniques to analyze when proposed constructions may inadvertently yield one-way functions.
